title: dendrobium bigibbum subvar. compactum
intro: Dendrobium bigibbum subvar. compactum, commonly known as the Queensland orchid, is a species of orchid native to Australia. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, fever, and inflammation, due to its health benefits of reducing fever and inflammation, and its therapeutic actions of acting as an expectorant and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of the Queensland orchid include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic potential of Dendrobium bigibbum subvar. compactum.
